title: Project Manager
required_skills: Managing civil engineering or construction projects
Project delivery with direct budget ownership (projects up to £2m)
Strong communication and stakeholder management, client-focused
Producing accurate project reports and progress updates
Health and safety industry standards and best practices
responsibilities: Manage the full project lifecycle from planning to completion
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams and oversee subcontractors
Ensure work is completed safely, on time, and within budget
Client communication, stakeholder management, and project reporting
Foresee risks and resolve issues promptly
